description: The applications to one of the user's projects (the Studio's Applicants tab), newest first, optionally for one role: each applicant's public profile card (name, handle, roles, location, website and social links, public films), their note and links, status, the owner's next moves, and the message thread. Open applications (submitted or shortlisted) by default; status all includes decided, withdrawn and closed ones.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).

role_id.description: Only the applications to this role.

status.description: open = still waiting on the owner (submitted or shortlisted, the default); all = every application, including accepted, declined, withdrawn and closed ones.

name: list_project_applications
title: List applications
